_comment: Report pages spell a property differently from the club's own listing, which
split one lake across two rows and halved its history. The canonical name is
always the one the club lists (it has a listing slug and a town); each variant
below has neither and appears only in a report page's property field.
Two look like aliases and are NOT. The club runs two properties called 'Twin
Lakes' - one at Cody Ranch in Coalgate, Oklahoma, one in Ben Wheeler, Texas -
and 'Moonshine Lake' likewise exists at Cody Ranch and at Walnut Springs.
Merging either pair would fuse lakes 200 miles apart.
The club reuses names across properties, so some rows are separated by town
before aliases are applied (see resolve_name_collisions). The Coalgate pairs
below are the same water reached under two labels once that split has run.

distinct.Twin Lakes (Coalgate): not Twin Lakes (Ben Wheeler) - 154 miles apart, both current
distinct.Moonshine Lake (Walnut Springs): retired; the club's Moonshine Lake has been at Coalgate since 2023
